summary: Frontend-only E2E validation of all 9 ACTIVE categories on external REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Full Playwright funnel ran for the 6 NEW unlocked categories (Fresher ₹199, Career Switcher ₹499, Laid Off Employee ₹499, Manager ₹499, Freelancer ₹499, Business Owner ₹499) plus Student ₹199 regression with upsells. Each ran: landing → start-analysis-btn → q-usertype-{type} → category-value-screen (correct product headline) → about → category-specific question steps (selects/multiselect/number/text with required fields enforced) → 5 binary personality choices → Generate. Each preview correctly showed the per-category VISIBLE scores and locked others, the unlock CTA price matched the plan (₹199 vs ₹499), and upsells were NOT visible pre-payment. MOCK Razorpay (pay-now-btn with 'Securely') unlocked full-report, exposing the expected report-section-* blocks for each category, download-pdf-btn, and the 4 upsell cards. Upsell regression on Student: selecting resume+interview produced addon-checkout-bar ₹798; mock pay unlocked addon-download-resume + addon-download-interview links. 100% of scripted assertions passed (7/7 categories + upsell).
critical_code_review_comments: PaymentModal.jsx still ships TWO buttons with the same data-testid='pay-now-btn' (live vs mock). Tests had to disambiguate by 'Securely' button text. Recommend splitting into 'pay-now-live-btn' and 'pay-now-mock-btn' for selector clarity (same callout from iteration_5).

ResultPreview.jsx (≈210 LOC) still owns preview, paywall, FullReport, payment trigger and upsell selection. Splitting <FullReport/>, <Upsells/>, addon checkout into separate files would improve maintainability (recurring observation).
Questionnaire.jsx step generation (steps=[...]) recomputes on every render along with catSteps lookup — memoize stepsFor/metaFor when schemas grow.
PROFILE_META still uses 'Fresher' product 'First-Job Readiness Report'. Frontend now passes through end-to-end (backend renders distinct Fresher copy verified). Good alignment.

All interactive elements (q-* fields, q-*-{option} chips, q-personality-*, q-pslider-*, q-usertype-*, locked-section unlock CTA, pay-now-btn, upsell-select-*, buy-addons-btn, addon-download-*, download-pdf-btn) have data-testid coverage — excellent testability.
